name: Microgrid restoration inrush-reserve check
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Identifies the declared source margin considered before introducing the assigned load or transformer.
description: Identifies the declared source margin considered before introducing the assigned load or transformer. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Available margin and connection demand” at the input and “Restoration reserve check” at the output. Transient performance needs validated studies.
